name: Rei Kawakubo
bio: Japanese designer. She founded Comme des Garçons and made black, loose, torn and lopsided clothes that questioned the shape of the body.

milestones.event: Founded the Comme des Garçons label in Tokyo.
Showed her first collection in Paris, in black, loose and torn clothes.
Showed Body Meets Dress, Dress Meets Body, with padded lumps on the body.
